verdict.rationale: Make documents an official MCP server that turns active and on-demand scenarios into callable tools for AI. External MCP clients such as Claude and ChatGPT can use it to run scenarios and to manage scenarios, connections, webhooks and data stores, which squarely delivers exposing workflows as MCP tools. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, and evidence that individual connected-app actions can be exposed directly rather than only through active/on-demand scenarios.
